message.subject: Re: Fattura n. 412
message.body_plain:
Grazie mille per la risposta veloce. Mi mandi anche la fattura di agosto, che non la trovo più.

Cordiali saluti
Elena Marchi
Ufficio amministrativo - Cartoleria Esempio Srl

cases.why: A thank-you that wraps a new request (the August invoice) with no question mark; the request is the content, so a reply is owed and calling it a courtesy silences the customer.

message.subject: Re: Printer error E-42
message.body_plain:
Thanks for the instructions. I did the reset as you said but the printer still shows error E-42 and won't print.

Regards,
Tom Hughes

cases.why: Polite opening, but it reports that the problem is still not solved, which the prompt lists explicitly as needing a reply.

message.subject: Re: Sopralluogo impianto
message.body_plain:
Va bene, grazie. Però giovedì non riesco più: possiamo fare martedì mattina, anche presto.

Giorgio Bassi

cases.why: Starts like a courtesy, then cancels the agreed day and proposes another without a question mark: an appointment we must confirm.

message.subject: Re: Consegne ottobre
message.body_plain:
Ricevuto, grazie. Vi segnalo che da lunedì 12 ottobre il nostro magazzino si sposta in Via dell'Artigianato 7, Lodi: le prossime consegne vanno lì.

Buona giornata
Paola Ferri

cases.why: Acknowledges, then gives a new delivery address we must act on; the prompt counts new facts we have to process as needing a reply.

message.subject: Re: Quote for 40 chairs
message.body_plain:
Great, thanks Marco. I'll wait for your revised quote with delivery included then.

Best,
Sarah Collins
Example Events Ltd

cases.why: Reads as thanks, but the customer is waiting for a revised quote from us: the ball is with us, which the prompt names as needing a reply.

message.subject: Re: Ritiro reso
message.body_plain:
Va bene, grazie. Devo però dirvi che sono molto deluso: è la terza volta che il corriere non trova il nostro indirizzo.

Marco Galli

cases.why: An acknowledgement followed by an explicit complaint about repeated failed pickups; dissatisfaction always needs a reply.

message.subject: Re: Maintenance contract
message.body_plain:
Ok thanks. Send me the signed copy as well, for our records.

J. Patel

cases.why: Two courtesy words, then an imperative request for a document; a short polite instruction is still a request.

message.subject: Re: Contratto di manutenzione
message.body_plain:
Grazie, ricevuto. Manca però la pagina 3 del contratto, quella con le condizioni di pagamento.

Saluti
Luisa Conti

cases.why: Confirms receipt but reports a missing page we must send; something is still open.

message.subject: Re: Lotto 2207
message.body_plain:
Thanks Giulia! Ci serve però anche il certificato di conformità per il lotto 2207, il cliente finale lo chiede entro venerdì.

Andrea

cases.why: English thanks, Italian request: the certificate is needed by Friday. Mixed languages must not hide the request.

message.subject: Re: Order 5531
message.body_plain:
Got it, thanks. Please cancel the second pallet from the order, we no longer need it.

Kind regards,
Mira Novak
Purchasing

cases.why: An instruction to change the order follows the acknowledgement; we must act on it and confirm.

message.subject: Re: Pratica 2231
message.body_plain:
Va bene, la ringrazio tanto. Buona giornata

Dott.ssa Carla Rinaldi
Studio Dentistico Rinaldi
Via Esempio 21, 20100 Milano
Tel. +39 02 0000 0141

cases.why: A pure closing courtesy followed by a signature block with address and phone, which the prompt says to ignore.

message.subject: Re: Wi-Fi not working
message.body_plain:
Perfect, it works now. Thank you so much for the quick help!

Daniel

cases.why: Confirms the fix worked and thanks us; nothing asked, reported or left open.

message.subject: Re: Documenti richiesti
message.body_plain:
Ricevuto, grazie mille.

Il giorno mar 29 set 2026 alle ore 10:12 Assistenza Esempio <assistenza@negozio-esempio.example>
ha scritto:
> Buongiorno, in allegato i documenti richiesti.
> Le serve altro?
> Assistenza Esempio

cases.why: Acknowledges receipt; the quoted trailer is our own earlier mail (cut by the engine before the model sees it, its question included), so only a thank-you remains.

message.subject: Re: Delivery slot
message.body_plain:
Thanks Marco, all clear now. Have a nice weekend.

Sarah

cases.why: Thanks, says everything is clear and closes with a greeting; nothing is open.

message.subject: Re: Intervento caldaia
message.body_plain:
Ok, perfetto così, la caldaia ora funziona. Grazie e buon lavoro

Roberto Sala
Sala Impianti Snc

AVVISO DI RISERVATEZZA: questo messaggio e i suoi allegati sono destinati esclusivamente al destinatario indicato. Se lo avete ricevuto per errore, vi preghiamo di cancellarlo e di darne comunicazione al mittente.

cases.why: Confirms the repair and thanks us; the only request-like words sit in a legal confidentiality footer, which the prompt says never makes a message need a reply.

message.subject: Re: Invoice 2026-118
message.body_plain:
Received, thanks.

All the best,
Tom Reed
Sales Manager | Example Logistics Ltd
+44 20 0000 0123

cases.why: Confirms receipt of the invoice; the rest is a signature with title and phone number.

message.subject: Re: Accesso al gestionale
message.body_plain:
Grazie a voi, tutto risolto! Thanks again

Francesca

cases.why: Says the problem is solved and thanks us in two languages; a pure close.

message.subject: Re: Password reset
message.body_plain: Brilliant, works now. Cheers

cases.why: Informal confirmation that the reset worked plus thanks; nothing open.

message.subject: Re: Spedizione ordine 884
message.body_plain: Ok, grazie

cases.why: A bare acknowledgement after our answer; the prompt names a bare 'ok' as a possible complete close, and nothing is asked or reported.

message.subject: Re: Your refund
message.body_plain: Thanks, I can see the refund on my card now. No need to reply.

cases.why: Confirms the refund arrived and says explicitly that no reply is needed.
